title: A switch with no expression
hints: A switch with no expression (`switch { … }`) runs the first case whose condition is true. It's a tidy if/else-if chain.
Order matters: a number divisible by 15 is also divisible by 3, so its case must come first. strconv.Itoa turns an int into its text.
switch { case n%15 == 0: return "FizzBuzz"; case n%3 == 0: return "Fizz"; case n%5 == 0: return "Buzz"; default: return strconv.Itoa(n) }
